frozen_hypothesis: Later recovery of the same breeding SiteIDs is associated with higher surrounding population states than their earlier loss, beyond structured temporal alignment with observed MasterSite abundance trajectories.

measurement_boundary: Ae and Ac are annual transition-state proxies from censuses bracketing observed loss/recovery transitions; they are not exact continuous-time thresholds.
mechanism_boundary: A supported result would establish history-dependent spatial recovery at the measured SiteID scale, not uniquely identify Allee effects, conspecific attraction, public information, or any single mechanism.
freeze_rule: After this frozen design SHA, no ecological definition, support threshold, SiteID rule, zero semantics, state-spell rule, transformation, hierarchy, weighting, null family, resample count, or interpretation gate may be changed in response to SMP hysteresis support/effect outcomes.
